business_summary: OMV Petrom is Romania's largest integrated oil and gas group, listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange (SNP), majority owned by Austria's OMV. It is the joint operator, with state gas producer Romgaz, of the Neptun Deep offshore gas project, the fixed Black Sea installation near which a marine drone was destroyed and that this whole chain is anchored on.

exposure_summary.narrative: OMV Petrom's sole offshore-counter-drone placement is offshore-energy-operator (CROWDED, impact 35/crowdedness 74), which the chain's own role text calls 'the anchor, included so the chain terminates honestly and not as a candidate': OMV Petrom is the party that PAYS for platform protection and books none of it as revenue, and the chain states plainly that 'gas price and the 2027 start date dominate anything this map does to these names', with protection spending itself a cost line no cited source sizes. The one exception the chain carries forward to the heat stage is schedule: Neptun Deep is on plan for a 2027 start, so a successful strike on the platform would be a schedule event, not primarily a security-underwriting event, for this name.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: counter-drone protection spending is not disclosed as a separate cost line by OMV Petrom; no revenue percentage applies since this is a cost exposure, not a revenue one, per the chain's own role text. See data_gaps.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 36,591,870,000 RON from the yfinance-statements statements in SNP-RO.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (36,591,870,000/61,344,440,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31: a revenue decline, consistent with gas and oil prices normalizing down from their 2022 post-invasion spike rather than any operational deterioration.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 2,751,440,000 RON divided by revenue 36,591,870,000 RON, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 9,000,400,000 RON divided by net income 3,058,030,000 RON, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 9,000,400,000 RON less capex 6,780,810,000 RON, divided by revenue 36,591,870,000 RON, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series; heavy capex (likely including Neptun Deep development spend) still leaves a positive but modest FCF margin.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -5,175,870,000 RON (total debt 2,026,100,000 less cash 7,201,970,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 5,955,330,000 RON (operating income 2,751,440,000 plus depreciation 3,203,890,000, period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series. Net cash position.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score PENDING_DATA in SNP-RO.json quality.piotroski: only 1 common fiscal period (2022-12-31) is available across the 9 inputs after alignment, and the year-over-year change legs need at least 2; not computable this run despite all 9 inputs individually being found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score PENDING_DATA in SNP-RO.json quality.beneish: only 1 common fiscal period (2022-12-31) is available across the 12 inputs, and every Beneish index is a year-over-year ratio; not computable this run.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 76,019,983,984 RON computed in SNP-RO.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 76,019,983,984 RON divided by revenue 36,591,870,000 RON for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 70,844,113,984 RON implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 2,219,590,000 RON, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon (5y 19.74%, 7y 15.14%, 10y 11.83%). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.

crowdedness_caveats: OMV Petrom's sole offshore-counter-drone link (offshore-energy-operator) is CROWDED (impact 35/crowdedness 74); the chain's own role text is explicit that this is the demand anchor included so the chain terminates honestly, not a candidate: OMV Petrom pays for protection and books none of it as revenue, and gas price plus the 2027 production start dominate the stock far more than any counter-drone spend.
